caseNameFull: Clark v. Kimmitt, Secretary of the Senate
judges: Appeal, Blackmun, Certiorari, Dismiss, Jurisdiction, Rehnqutst, Taken, Treat, Want, Whereon, Writ

opinions.text:
Affirmed on appeal from C. A. D. C. Cir.

Mr. Justice Blackmun, Mr. Justice Rehnqutst, and Mr. Justice Stevens would dismiss the appeal for want of jurisdiction, treat the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, and deny certiorari.
